title: cassia tetraphylla var. ramosa
intro: Cassia tetraphylla var. ramosa, commonly known as "Umbrella Tree", is a tropical plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family, native to the tropical regions of Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and promoting immune function. The plant's therapeutic actions include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Cassia tetraphylla var. ramosa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
